summary: Build practical health and safety compliance skills with legal registers, risk assessments, audits, and incident investigations. Enquire today.
lede: Health and safety compliance training helps safety professionals connect occupational safety obligations with practical workplace controls. It is designed for health and safety managers, compliance officers, supervisors, and internal auditors who need to make those obligations traceable in daily operations. Participants learn to maintain legal registers, assess hazards and risks, verify controls, investigate incidents, and report audit findings and corrective actions.
audienceIntro: Health and safety compliance professionals who interpret duties, manage controls, investigate events, or report workplace risk will find the course directly relevant. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with safety procedures or operational risk and need a more consistent compliance system.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience with workplace safety procedures, operational supervision, compliance coordination, or risk assessment. Familiarity with your organization’s incident reporting process and internal safety documentation will help you apply the exercises. No programming is required. Advanced digital topics such as AI-assisted document classification and dashboard workflows are covered at an operational application level.
